AGENDA
  CIVIL SERVICE COMMISSION
  VIA TELECONFERENCE ONLY
 Welcome to Glendale City Hall. Meetings are broadcast on Spectrum Cable, channel 6, AT&T U-
 verse, channel 99, and streaming live in high definition (HD) on the city's webpage,
 glendaleca.gov/live. In addition, city meetings are available on YouTube.com/myglendale and on
 Apple TV, Roku, and Amazon Fire devices using a free app called Screenweave and choosing
 “Glendale TV” from the menu. Call (818) 548-4013 for program schedules. DVDs of the proceedings
 are available for purchase in the City Clerk’s Office. Meetings are also archived on the City Website for
 viewing anytime at glendaleca.gov/agendas. If you have any question about matters on the agenda, or
 requests for assistance, please contact Human Resources at (818) 548-2110 during regular business
 hours.

  PLEASE TURN OF CELLULAR PHONES WHILE INSIDE THE COUNCIL CHAMBER.

 In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990, auxiliary hearing aids, sign
 language translation, and Braille transcripts are available upon request. Assisted listening devices
 are available same-day upon request. At least 48 hours (or two business days) notice is required
 for requests regarding sign language translation and Braille transcription services. All documents
 related to open session items on this agenda that are received less than 72 hours prior to this
 meeting, and are public records, will be available for review in the Office of the City Clerk, 613 E.
 Broadway, RM 110, Glendale, CA 91206.
 Translation services are provided for meetings through the use of bilingual staff for speakers who
 wish to utilize the service as available. Speakers should state their request by contacting the City
 Clerk’s office at (818) 548-2090, at least 24 hours prior to the scheduled meeting. Please specify
 the language for which you require translation. The exclusive use of City provided interpreters is not
 required and persons are welcome to use their own interpreter or speak in their native language.
  AUGUST 11, 2021 AT 5:00 PM

To help slow the transmission of COVID-19, and protect the health and safety of the community, the
Civil Service Commission will continue to be closed to the public for in-person attendance.

The public is encouraged to watch and participate from the safety of their homes to practice social
distancing.

The meetings can be viewed:
  • On local cable Charter Cable Channel 6 and AT&T U-verse Channel 99.
   • Streaming in high definition online at glendaleca.gov/live, YouTube.com/myglendale, and a free
  app called Screenweave on Apple TV, Roku, and Amazon Fire devices. Choose “Glendale
  TV” from the menu.

For public comments and questions during the meeting, call (818) 937-8100. City staff will be
submitting these questions and comments in real time to the appropriate person during the Civil
Service Commission meeting.

1.  ROLL CALL
2.  MINUTES (Page 4)
  Action: Consideration of the Minutes for the meetings of June 9, 2021.
3.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
  Discussion is limited to items not part of the agenda. Each speaker is limited to five minutes.
  Commission may question or respond to the speaker but there will be no debate or decision.
4.  RECRUITMENT AND EXAMINATION REPORT (Page 6)
  No action required.
5.  ELIGIBLE LISTS ESTABLISHED (Page 8)
  No action required.
6.  CLASS SPECIFICATION FOR APPROVAL – ASSISTANT CITY CLERK SERIES
  (PETROSYAN) (Page 9)
  Action: Approval of class specification for Assistant City Clerk Series as submitted.
7.  CLASS SPECIFICATIONS FOR APPROVAL – CODE COMPLIANCE INSPECTION
  SERIES, HOUSING ADMINISTRATIVE SERIES, HOUSING ADVISOR SERIES,
  NEIGHBORHOOD SERVICES SUPERVISOR SERIES, PERMIT SERVICES TECHNICIAN
  SERIES, AND ADMINISTRATIVE SPECIALIST SERIES/CDD (PETROSYAN) (Page 15)
  Action: Approval of class specifications for Code Compliance Inspection Series, Housing
  Administrative Series, Housing Advisor Series, Neighborhood Services Supervisor Series,
  Permit Services Technician Series, And Administrative Specialist Series/CDD as submitted.
8.  CLASS SPECIFICATION FOR APPROVAL – CYBERSECURITY MANAGER (NAVARRO)
  (Page 58)
  Action: Approval of class specification for Cybersecurity Manager as submitted.
9.  CLASS SPECIFICATION FOR APPROVAL – IT APPLICATIONS SERIES (NAVARRO)
  (Page 65)
  Action: Approval of class specification for IT Applications Series as submitted.
10.  CLASS SPECIFICATION FOR APPROVAL – HOMELESS PROGRAMS SERIES
  (BABAYAN) (Page 73)
  Action: Approval of class specification for Homeless Programs Series as submitted.
11.  JOB BULLETIN FOR APPROVAL – DEPUTY DIRECTOR OF COMMUNITY
  DEVELOPMENT/ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT (PETROSYAN) (Page 82)
   Action: Approval of job bulletin for Deputy Director of Community Development/Economic
  Development as submitted.
12.  JOB BULLETIN FOR APPROVAL – WASTEWATER MAINTENANCE WORKER
  (PETROSYAN) (Page 88)
  Action: Approval of job bulletin for Wastewater Maintenance Worker as submitted.
13.  JOB BULLETIN FOR APPROVAL – POLICE SERGEANT (NAVARRO) (Page 94)
  Action: Approval of job bulletin for Police Sergeant as submitted.
14.  REPORTS - INFORMATION (Page 99)
  a) Employee Job Performance Evaluations
15.  CIVIL SERVICE COMMISSION/STAFF COMMENTS
16.  CLOSED SESSION (Page 100)
  a) Public Employee Appointment: Reinstatement Request – Building Repairer
17.  ADJOURNMENT

  The Agenda for the August 11, 2021 Civil Service Commission meeting was posted on the
  Bulletin Board Outside City Hall.
